name: Stillwater Lodge
description: An immersive lakeside lodge concept with complete stays, room galleries, experiences, dining, and a validated local stay planner.
tagline: A little closer to doing nothing.

notes.layout: inset cinematic lake hero, centered serif identity, portrait narratives, room archive, full split menu and complete stay planner
notes.motion: hero image settle, intersection reveals, scroll-snap room gallery, hover and modal transitions
notes.interaction: filter room families, browse room galleries, select dining menus and experiences, validate dates/capacity, calculate and save a local itinerary
notes.provenance: Original nine-page hospitality concept with independent brand, writing, image selection and local planning logic. No real inventory, reservations or payments.
